direction: higher layers may depend on the same or lower layers only

layers.description: composition metadata, envelopes, state and provider transport
application and optional team capabilities; excluded from the frozen L0-L5 core-source identity

resolution: Longest matching declared module/package prefix applies to both source and imports; child ownership cannot exempt reverse imports or same-layer cycles.

module_boundary_rationale.cgkn.runtime.node_authority: Permit/receipt authority depends on contracts and persisted facts, not scheduler execution. GraphEditRejected now belongs to tree edit contracts.
module_boundary_rationale.cgkn.telemetry: Runtime observation and read-only projections depend on stored facts; application Oracle qualification has moved out.
module_boundary_rationale.cgkn.telemetry.trusted_samples: High-level receipt-qualified samples use the runtime acceptance assembly.
module_boundary_rationale.cgkn.state.repair: Repair advisory projection consumes compiled protocol; no state ownership is moved.
module_boundary_rationale.cgkn.protocol: Compiler/exchange orchestration, with explicit low-level lexical/context contracts for Provider use.
module_boundary_rationale.cgkn.adapters: Core projection adapters; capability/Skill mutation adapters are higher-level composition.
